title: Explicit Runner Registry and Dispatch Contract
goal: Replace regex-based runner discovery with an explicit registry contract that maps supported tools to executors and capability metadata while preserving current safety gates and runner behavior.
scope: Runner registry, worker orchestration dispatch mapping, capability metadata validation, and runner registry tests.
generation_reason: Code review found api/app/services/runner_registry.py discovers tools by regex-scanning workers/orchestration/tasks.py for request.tool comparisons. Tests cover current behavior, but the contract is brittle as runner coverage grows.

review_findings: workers/orchestration/tasks.py contains a long if-chain for tool dispatch

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until this package is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Refactor registry and dispatch contract only. Do not add new runners, broaden tool behavior, or alter runtime safety gates.
constraints.preserve_runner_behavior: All existing supported tools must remain registered with identical names and execution behavior.

success_criteria: Runner registry no longer parses Python source with regex to discover supported tools.
A single explicit registry or equivalent structured contract defines supported tool names and dispatch handlers.
Capability metadata completeness tests still prove every registered tool has metadata and every metadata entry maps to a registered tool.
SUPPORTED_TOOLS remains compatible for existing services and tests or is replaced with an equivalent stable API.
No runner execution semantics, risk tiers, approval gates, scope checks, or credential handling changes.

acceptance_criteria: Registry completeness is explicit and deterministic.
All pre-existing registered tools remain present with no name drift.
No live scans, runtime mutation, approval bypass, scope bypass, credential materialization, or kill-switch bypass occurs.

before_promotion: NEXT_TASK.md must contain this task as the single active task.
after_completion: Promote the next true open task into NEXT_TASK.md, or record that no active backlog task remains in NEXT_TASK.md.

out_of_scope: Adding, deleting, or materially changing runner implementations.
Changing risk tiers, approval requirements, or scope validation rules.
Changing finding schemas or reporting formats.
Changing live runtime binding or capability pack lifecycle.
